visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a static graphic featuring a square black container filled with white rice and topped with chopped green onions, set against a light brown wooden table background. Bold text overlays in Chinese appear at the top and bottom of the frame. (2) A young woman with long, slightly wavy brown hair and a light pink knitted sweater is sitting at a white desk in a neutral, brightly lit room. She holds a smartphone with both hands, looking down with a somber and disappointed facial expression, her mouth slightly downturned. (3) A close-up of the smartphone screen reveals a chat interface with blue and white message bubbles. The woman's thumb interacts with the screen while animated text bubbles float above. Her face remains visible in the background, appearing contemplative. (4) The woman is shown holding a transparent plastic meal box with an orange and white label that reads 'Sushi Express gogo.' She looks at it with wide eyes and an open mouth, conveying shock and confusion. The background is a clean domestic setting. (5) She turns the meal box over to show the bottom, which is transparent, revealing a dense layer of sushi ingredients including salmon, crab meat, and egg underneath the rice. She smiles broadly, looking directly into the camera with excitement. (6) The scene shifts to a retail store environment, showing the 'Sushi Express gogo' sign and refrigerated display cases filled with various packaged sushi meals. The lighting is bright and commercial. People can be seen walking in the background of the mall hallway. (7) A fast-paced montage displays different sushi boxes in close-up. One box shows grilled meat and seafood, while another features abundant salmon slices. Hands are shown interacting with the packaging, specifically peeling back a sticker label on the side of the box to reveal text underneath. (8) The woman stands in front of the store's refrigerated display, holding two meal boxes and two red squeeze pouches. She waves them slightly and smiles brightly at the camera, her expression cheerful and inviting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop music starts with a prominent synthesized drum beat. A male narrator begins with a professional and energetic tone. A clear 'ding' digital notification sound occurs as chat bubbles appear. The acoustic environment is clean and sterile. (2) The female voice enters, speaking with a lower pitch and slower rate to convey disappointment about her meal. The music continues as a steady background layer. (3) A sudden high-pitched 'Pop' sound effect triggers as a surprise is revealed. The male voice returns with increased intensity and a much faster speech rate, sounding highly excited and persuasive. (4) Sounds of thin plastic rustling are heard as the meal box is flipped and stickers are peeled. These foley-like sounds are crisp and placed prominently in the mix to emphasize tactile interaction. (5) The male narrator continues his energetic delivery, describing food items with a rhythmic cadence that matches the visual transitions. The music maintains its driving electronic pulse until the very end. (6) The audio concludes with a final cheerful phrase from both voices layered over a bright synthesizer chord, ending the track with a positive and high-arousal resolution.
